proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ E _ _ x y
  constructor
  · intro h t
    have h1 : inner 𝕜 x (t • y) = 0 := by rw [inner_smul_right, h, mul_zero]
    have h2 := norm_add_sq_eq_norm_sq_add_norm_sq_of_inner_eq_zero (𝕜 := 𝕜) x (t • y) h1
    have h3 : ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖x + t • y‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖t • y‖]
    exact (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _) two_ne_zero).mp h3
  · intro h
    by_cases hy : y = 0
    · simp [hy]
    have hy2 : (inner 𝕜 y y : 𝕜) ≠ 0 := inner_self_ne_zero.mpr hy
    set c : 𝕜 := inner 𝕜 y x / inner 𝕜 y y with hc
    have h0 : inner 𝕜 y (x - c • y) = 0 := by
      rw [inner_sub_right, inner_smul_right, hc, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hy2, sub_self]
    have h1 : inner 𝕜 (x - c • y) (c • y) = 0 := by
      rw [inner_smul_right, ← inner_conj_symm, h0]; simp
    have h2 := norm_add_sq_eq_norm_sq_add_norm_sq_of_inner_eq_zero (𝕜 := 𝕜) (x - c • y) (c • y) h1
    rw [sub_add_cancel] at h2
    have h3 := h (-c)
    have h4 : x + (-c) • y = x - c • y := by rw [neg_smul, sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [h4] at h3
    have h5 : ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖x - c • y‖ ^ 2 := (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _) two_ne_zero).mpr h3
    have h6 : ‖c • y‖ ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by linarith
    have h7 : ‖c • y‖ = 0 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg (c • y)]
    have h8 : c = 0 := by
      have := norm_eq_zero.mp h7
      exact (smul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_right hy
    have h9 : inner 𝕜 y x = 0 := by
      rw [hc, div_eq_zero_iff] at h8
      exact h8.resolve_right hy2
    rw [← inner_conj_symm, h9]; simp
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] (x y : E), inner 𝕜 x y = 0 ↔ ∀ t : 𝕜, ‖x‖ ≤ ‖x + t • y‖
